title: Do you dream in first person or third person?
content: I saw a TikTok posing this question and it interested me. In my dreams (which are usually at the mall..) my perspective often switches from first to third, but most of it is third person. In fact, my most memorable visuals of the mall’s structure are when the dream’s viewpoint is quite zoomed out, showing my descent down an escalator, for example. I’m curious about others’ experiences!
